title.en: The Public Works Appropriation Act of 1956
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Otherwise Known as “The Public Works Appropriation Act of 1956”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1530_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, particularly item "as Samar," Roman Numeral II, is hereby amended so as to include the following appropriations:
"49. Minarog Barrio School Building, Montiong—Construction and Improvement 4,000.00 "50. Mualbual Barrio School Building, Zumarraga —Repair, improvement and reconstruction 4,000.00 "51. Malakining Barrio School Building, Talalora—Repair, improvement and reconstruction 4,000.00 "52. Loquilocon Barrio School Building, Wright—Construction and improvement 4,000.00 "53. Paco Barrio School Building, Wright—Construction and improvement 4,000.00 "54. Lamingao Barrio School Building, San Sebastian—Construction and improvement 3,400.00 "55. Dolores Barrio School Building, San Sebastian—Construction and improvement 3,400.00 "56. Maylobe Barrio School Building, Motiong—Construction and improvement 4,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon it approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
